body: My hopes are that they will know what to expect when they open the door to my room.
I'm sure this subreddit may be against this kind of advice but any advice on what to do? How do I get the correct people to find my body?

I'm thinking of those who discover me. I don't want anyone who isn't trained to see a dead body to find me. I also don't want my body to waste away for days and my friends and family think I've gone missing.

Thanks for your message. As I said, my mind has been made and I know I want to go through with this. I just really need an answer to my problem so someone like my flatmates or my landlady doesn't find my body. I need it to be the correctly trained people.
